result.summary: A bar chart titled 'Enterprise BI: Too Little Data And Too Hard to Use' shows reasons why users avoid enterprise BI applications. The top reason is 'Do not have all the data you need' at 45%, followed by 'Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use' at 32%, and 'Take too long to get results' at 29%. The data is from a 2014 study by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, based on 302 business and IT decision-makers.
key_facts: 45% of respondents cite lack of data as the main reason for not using enterprise BI applications.
32% find enterprise applications too complex, complicated, or cumbersome to use.
29% report that it takes too long to get results.
The study was commissioned by SAP in March 2014 and surveyed 302 business and IT decision-makers.
visible_text: Enterprise BI: Too Little Data And Too Hard to Use
Why do you sometimes choose not to use enterprise BI applications?
Do not have all the data you need 45%
Are too complex, complicated, cumbersome to use 32%
Do not have the right data model, relationships, attributes, hierarchies 31%
Take too long to get results 29%
Have data models (relationships, keys, joins) that are too restrictive 23%
Base: 302 business and IT decision-makers who influence BI decisions
Source: A commissioned study conducted by Forrester Consulting on behalf of SAP, March 2014
